title: Simple and great app
body:
I love this app. It’s easy to use, has an attractive UI, and the completion sound is rewarding.

I have a few suggestions:

1. Add a notification sound: This would serve as a cue to start a habit. Currently, reminders just appearing in my notifications feel invisible, often getting covered by other notifications. For example, my shopping app has a notification sound that makes it more noticeable.

2. Progress calendar tab: Having a calendar to track accomplishments over a month or longer would be motivating for me. It serves as a visual reminder that you’re making progress.

3. Widget extension: Adding a widget would make the app more visible and easier to access.

4. iPad version: I wish there was an iPad version of this app, especially with a journaling feature. The ability to write would be a great addition. And adding the ability to sync between my phone and iPad would be great. This would make tracking habits more accessible, allowing me to keep up with my progress no matter which device I have with me.
